title: openai-v1-chat-compat-param-harmonize-stream-heartbeat-tool-negotiation
author: Asha Patel
description: Harmonize OpenAI /v1/chat.completions compatibility surface with Redwood runtime to improve streaming stability and tool calling negotiation. This PR normalizes parameter mappings, consolidates stop token handling, maps OpenAI logprobs to the internal top_logprobs shape, and introduces a lightweight stream heartbeat plus fragment coalescer to reduce partial-json drops in adverse network conditions. Includes a handshake extension to the functioncall streaming envelope to avoid ambiguous tool invocation boundaries and a structured output sanitizer for JSON-mode responses. The change set contains unit and integration tests, updated docs for the compatibility layer, and compatibility shims to preserve behavior for legacy clients. Checklist: 1) Param normalization table and conversion layer added. 2) Stop handling unified across adapters and serving runtime. 3) Streaming heartbeat and fragment coalescing implemented. 4) Functioncall handshake and tool metadata framing added. 5) Mapping of logprob fields to OpenAI v1 shape. 6) Tests and docs updated. Related work: ENG-4512, PM-112.
